sentences.text: This guy escaped being eaten alive, with the worst dad joke in history.
Odysseus and his men were trapped in a cave with a giant Cyclops.
He blocked the door with a boulder, and started eating them.
Easy fix: kill him while he sleeps, right?
Wrong.
Only the giant could move that boulder.
Kill him, and you starve inside.
So Odysseus offered him wine.
Strong wine.
No water.
The giant asked his name.
My name, he said, is Nobody.
Then the Cyclops passed out.
They heated a sharpened olive stake in the fire, and drove it into his one eye.
He screamed for his Cyclops neighbors.
Who's hurting you?
Nobody is killing me!
Well, if nobody's hurting you, go back to sleep.
At dawn, the blind giant rolled the boulder away himself, and the men slipped out under his sheep.
Saved by a fake name.
Nobody saw that coming.
